UpdateSourceArgs: -c "for Tool in wget jq tar; do if ! command -v \"$Tool\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo \"$Tool is required but was not found. Aborting\"; exit 1; fi; done; cd \"{{$FullRootDir}}\" || exit 1; case \"$(uname -m)\" in x86_64) Arch=x64;; aarch64) Arch=aarch64;; *) echo \"Unsupported architecture $(uname -m)\"; exit 1;; esac; Installed=\"\"; if [[ -x java/bin/java ]]; then Installed=$(java/bin/java --version 2>&1 | grep -oE \"Temurin-[^ ]+\" | head -n1 | cut -d- -f2); fi; Latest=$(wget -qO- \"https://api.adoptium.net/v3/assets/latest/{{SpecificInstanceJavaVersion}}/hotspot?architecture=$Arch&image_type=jre&os=linux&vendor=eclipse\" | jq -r \".[0].version.openjdk_version\" | sed \"s/-LTS$//\"); if [[ -z \"$Latest\" || \"$Latest\" == \"null\" ]]; then echo \"Could not get the latest Eclipse Temurin {{SpecificInstanceJavaVersion}} version. Aborting\"; exit 1; fi; if [[ \"$Installed\" == \"$Latest\" ]]; then echo \"Eclipse Temurin Java $Latest already installed. Skipping\"; exit 0; fi; rm -f java.tar.gz; wget -qO java.tar.gz \"https://api.adoptium.net/v3/binary/latest/{{SpecificInstanceJavaVersion}}/ga/linux/$Arch/jre/hotspot/normal/eclipse\" || { echo \"Download failed from the Eclipse Temurin CDN. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; mkdir -p java && rm -rf java/* && tar -xzf java.tar.gz -C java --strip-components=1 && rm -f java.tar.gz && chmod +x java/bin/java && echo \"Eclipse Temurin Java $Latest installed\";"

-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location -Path '{{$FullRootDir}}'; $Installed = ''; if (Test-Path 'java/bin/java.exe') { $Out = (& 'java/bin/java.exe' --version 2>&1) -join ' '; if ($Out -match 'Temurin-(\S+)') { $Installed = $Matches[1] } }; try { $Latest = ((Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://api.adoptium.net/v3/assets/latest/{{SpecificInstanceJavaVersion}}/hotspot?architecture=x64&image_type=jre&os=windows&vendor=eclipse' -ErrorAction Stop)[0].version.openjdk_version) -replace '-LTS$', '' } catch { $Latest = '' }; if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Latest)) { Write-Output 'Could not get the latest Eclipse Temurin {{SpecificInstanceJavaVersion}} version. Aborting'; exit 1 }; if ($Installed -eq $Latest) { Write-Output ('Eclipse Temurin Java ' + $Latest + ' already installed. Skipping'); exit 0 }; Remove-Item java.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://api.adoptium.net/v3/binary/latest/{{SpecificInstanceJavaVersion}}/ga/windows/x64/jre/hotspot/normal/eclipse' -OutFile java.zip -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output 'Download failed from the Eclipse Temurin CDN. Aborting'; exit 1 }; Remove-Item java-extract -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Expand-Archive -Path java.zip -DestinationPath java-extract -Force; Remove-Item java.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item java -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Get-ChildItem -Path java-extract -Directory | Select-Object -First 1 | Move-Item -Destination java; Remove-Item java-extract -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output ('Eclipse Temurin Java ' + $Latest + ' installed');"

-c "for Tool in wget jq unzip; do if ! command -v \"$Tool\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo \"$Tool is required but was not found. Aborting\"; exit 1; fi; done; Repo=\"{{UpdaterRepo}}\"; Want=\"{{UpdaterVersion}}\"; Dir=\"{{$FullRootDir}}updater\"; mkdir -p \"$Dir\"; case \"$(uname -m)\" in x86_64) Arch=amd64;; aarch64) Arch=arm64;; *) echo \"Unsupported architecture $(uname -m)\"; exit 1;; esac; Auth=(); if [[ -n \"{{GithubToken}}\" ]]; then Auth=(--header \"Authorization: Bearer {{GithubToken}}\"); fi; if [[ -z \"$Want\" ]]; then Api=\"https://api.github.com/repos/$Repo/releases/latest\"; else Api=\"https://api.github.com/repos/$Repo/releases/tags/$Want\"; fi; Json=$(wget -qO- \"${Auth[@]}\" \"$Api\") || { echo \"Failed to query GitHub releases of $Repo. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; Tag=$(echo \"$Json\" | jq -r \".tag_name // empty\"); if [[ -z \"$Tag\" ]]; then echo \"No release found in $Repo. Aborting\"; exit 1; fi; Url=$(echo \"$Json\" | jq -r --arg suffix \"-linux-$Arch.zip\" '.assets[] | select(.name | endswith($suffix)) | .browser_download_url' | head -n1); Installed=\"\"; if [[ -x \"$Dir/gtnh-daily-updater\" ]]; then Installed=$(\"$Dir/gtnh-daily-updater\" --version 2>/dev/null | grep -oE \"version [^ ]+\" | head -n1 | cut -d\" \" -f2); fi; if [[ \"$Installed\" == \"$Tag\" ]]; then echo \"gtnh-daily-updater $Tag already installed. Skipping\"; exit 0; fi; if [[ -z \"$Url\" ]]; then echo \"Release $Tag of $Repo has no linux-$Arch build. Aborting\"; exit 1; fi; rm -f \"$Dir/updater.zip\"; wget -qO \"$Dir/updater.zip\" \"$Url\" || { echo \"gtnh-daily-updater download failed. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; unzip -oq \"$Dir/updater.zip\" -d \"$Dir\" || { echo \"Failed to extract gtnh-daily-updater (is unzip installed?). Aborting\"; exit 1; }; rm -f \"$Dir/updater.zip\"; chmod +x \"$Dir/gtnh-daily-updater\"; echo \"gtnh-daily-updater $Tag installed\";"

-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $Repo = '{{UpdaterRepo}}'; $Want = '{{UpdaterVersion}}'; $Token = '{{GithubToken}}'; $Dir = Join-Path '{{$FullRootDir}}' 'updater'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $Dir | Out-Null; $Headers = @{ 'User-Agent' = 'AMP-gtnh-daily' }; if ($Token -ne '') { $Headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer ' + $Token }; if ($Want -eq '') { $Api = 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + $Repo + '/releases/latest' } else { $Api = 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + $Repo + '/releases/tags/' + $Want }; try { $Release = Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Headers $Headers -Uri $Api -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output ('Failed to query GitHub releases of ' + $Repo + '. Aborting'); exit 1 }; $Tag = $Release.tag_name; if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Tag)) { Write-Output ('No release found in ' + $Repo + '. Aborting'); exit 1 }; $Exe = Join-Path $Dir 'gtnh-daily-updater.exe'; $Installed = ''; if (Test-Path $Exe) { $Out = (& $Exe --version 2>$null) -join ' '; if ($Out -match 'version\s+(\S+)') { $Installed = $Matches[1] } }; if ($Installed -eq $Tag) { Write-Output ('gtnh-daily-updater ' + $Tag + ' already installed. Skipping'); exit 0 }; $Asset = $Release.assets | Where-Object { $_.name -like '*-windows-amd64.zip' } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $Asset) { Write-Output ('Release ' + $Tag + ' of ' + $Repo + ' has no windows-amd64 build. Aborting'); exit 1 }; $Zip = Join-Path $Dir 'updater.zip'; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $Asset.browser_download_url -OutFile $Zip -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output 'gtnh-daily-updater download failed. Aborting'; exit 1 }; Expand-Archive -Path $Zip -DestinationPath $Dir -Force; Remove-Item $Zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output ('gtnh-daily-updater ' + $Tag + ' installed');"

-c "for Tool in wget unzip; do if ! command -v \"$Tool\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo \"$Tool is required but was not found. Aborting\"; exit 1; fi; done; cd \"{{$FullBaseDir}}\" || exit 1; if [[ -f lwjgl3ify-forgePatches.jar ]]; then echo \"Server files already present. Skipping base pack install\"; exit 0; fi; Ver=\"{{InitialConfigVersion}}\"; Url=\"{{BasePackUrl}}\"; if [[ -z \"$Url\" ]]; then if [[ \"$Ver\" =~ ^[0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.][0-9]+$ ]]; then Url=\"https://downloads.gtnewhorizons.com/ServerPacks/GT_New_Horizons_${Ver}_Server_Java_17-25.zip\"; else echo \"Initial Config Version $Ver is not a stable release, so no server pack can be downloaded for it. Set Base Server Pack URL or upload the server files. Aborting\"; exit 1; fi; fi; echo \"Downloading GTNH server pack from $Url\"; rm -f base-pack.zip; wget -qO base-pack.zip \"$Url\" || { echo \"Server pack download failed. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; unzip -oq base-pack.zip -d . || { echo \"Failed to extract server pack (is unzip installed?). Aborting\"; exit 1; }; rm -f base-pack.zip; echo \"GTNH server pack installed\";"

-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location -Path '{{$FullBaseDir}}'; if (Test-Path 'lwjgl3ify-forgePatches.jar') { Write-Output 'Server files already present. Skipping base pack install'; exit 0 }; $Ver = '{{InitialConfigVersion}}'; $Url = '{{BasePackUrl}}'; if ($Url -eq '') { if ($Ver -match '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$') { $Url = 'https://downloads.gtnewhorizons.com/ServerPacks/GT_New_Horizons_' + $Ver + '_Server_Java_17-25.zip' } else { Write-Output ('Initial Config Version ' + $Ver + ' is not a stable release, so no server pack can be downloaded for it. Set Base Server Pack URL or upload the server files. Aborting'); exit 1 }; }; Write-Output ('Downloading GTNH server pack from ' + $Url); Remove-Item base-pack.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $Url -OutFile base-pack.zip -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output 'Server pack download failed. Aborting'; exit 1 }; Expand-Archive -Path base-pack.zip -DestinationPath . -Force; Remove-Item base-pack.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output 'GTNH server pack installed';"

-c "U=\"{{$FullRootDir}}updater/gtnh-daily-updater\"; D=\"{{$FullBaseDir}}\"; if ! command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo \"git is required to merge pack config changes but was not found. Aborting\"; exit 1; fi; if [[ ! -x \"$U\" ]]; then echo \"gtnh-daily-updater is missing. Aborting\"; exit 1; fi; export GITHUB_TOKEN=\"{{GithubToken}}\"; if [[ ! -f \"${D}.gtnh-daily-updater.json\" ]]; then echo \"Initializing gtnh-daily-updater (config version {{InitialConfigVersion}}, mode {{PackMode}})\"; \"$U\" init --instance-dir \"$D\" --side server --mode \"{{PackMode}}\" --config \"{{InitialConfigVersion}}\" || { echo \"gtnh-daily-updater init failed. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; fi; Extra=(); if [[ \"{{ModVersions}}\" == \"latest\" ]]; then Extra+=(--latest); fi; \"$U\" update --instance-dir \"$D\" --cache-dir \"{{$FullRootDir}}updater/cache\" --concurrency \"{{Concurrency}}\" \"${Extra[@]}\" || { echo \"gtnh-daily-updater update failed. Aborting\"; exit 1; };"

-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$U = Join-Path '{{$FullRootDir}}' 'updater\gtnh-daily-updater.exe'; $D = ('{{$FullBaseDir}}').TrimEnd('\', '/'); if ($null -eq (Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Output 'git is required to merge pack config changes but was not found. Install Git for Windows. Aborting'; exit 1 }; if (-not (Test-Path $U)) { Write-Output 'gtnh-daily-updater is missing. Aborting'; exit 1 }; $env:GITHUB_TOKEN = '{{GithubToken}}'; $env:GIT_CONFIG_COUNT = '1'; $env:GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0 = 'core.longpaths'; $env:GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0 = 'true'; if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $D '.gtnh-daily-updater.json'))) { Write-Output 'Initializing gtnh-daily-updater (config version {{InitialConfigVersion}}, mode {{PackMode}})'; & $U init --instance-dir $D --side server --mode '{{PackMode}}' --config '{{InitialConfigVersion}}'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output 'gtnh-daily-updater init failed. Aborting'; exit 1 }; }; $UpdateArgs = @('update', '--instance-dir', $D, '--cache-dir', (Join-Path '{{$FullRootDir}}' 'updater\cache'), '--concurrency', '{{Concurrency}}'); if ('{{ModVersions}}' -eq 'latest') { $UpdateArgs += '--latest' }; & $U @UpdateArgs; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output 'gtnh-daily-updater update failed. Aborting'; exit 1 };"
